Plan Your Journey

Journey Inspiration

Tours &
Excursions

Every journey with The Madagascar Collection is bespoke. These example itineraries show what’s possible — your trip will be tailored entirely around you.

North West Madagascar

Nosy Be
Nosy Be

Whale Shark Excursion

Snorkel alongside the world’s largest fish in warm waters off the northwest coast. Eco-conscious, guided by marine specialists.

Whale Shark Excursion

Nosy Be

Experience one of the ocean’s most extraordinary encounters. These gentle giants gather seasonally off Madagascar’s northwest coast. Guided by experienced marine specialists, this responsible, eco-conscious excursion combines adventure with conservation — a must for nature lovers seeking a truly unforgettable marine safari.

Enquire About This Tour
Nosy Sakatia

Snorkelling with Turtles at Sakatia

Close encounters with resident green sea turtles in the crystal-clear bays of Nosy Sakatia. Ideal for all experience levels.

Snorkelling with Turtles at Sakatia

Nosy Sakatia

Discover the calm, crystal-clear waters surrounding Nosy Sakatia, renowned for its resident population of green sea turtles. Sheltered bays provide excellent visibility and vibrant coral reefs, making it one of the best places in Madagascar for marine wildlife encounters.

Enquire About This Tour
Nosy Be

Nosy Be Day Tour

Ylang-ylang plantations, volcanic crater lakes, Mont Passot, sacred lakes, local markets and villages — the best of Nosy Be in one curated day.

Nosy Be Day Tour

Nosy Be

Explore the highlights of Nosy Be on a curated day excursion. From fragrant ylang-ylang plantations and volcanic lakes to panoramic viewpoints such as Mont Passot, sacred lakes, local markets and authentic villages. Perfect for first-time visitors seeking an immersive introduction to Madagascar’s most popular island destination.

Enquire About This Tour
Nosy Komba

Nosy Komba Lemur Excursion

Observe friendly black lemurs in the wild, visit traditional villages and browse handicraft markets on the Island of Lemurs.

Nosy Komba Lemur Excursion

Nosy Komba

Just a short boat ride from Nosy Be, Nosy Komba is known as the Island of Lemurs. Guided walks through lush forests offer black lemur encounters, traditional village visits and local handicraft markets. A favourite stop on northern Madagascar itineraries.

Enquire About This Tour
Lokobe, Nosy Be

Lokobe Guided Forest Walk

One of Madagascar’s last lowland rainforests. By day: black lemurs, chameleons, rare birds. By night: a world of nocturnal wildlife.

Lokobe Guided Forest Walk

Lokobe, Nosy Be

Step into one of Madagascar’s last remaining lowland rainforests in Lokobe National Park. Day walks reveal endemic species including black lemurs, chameleons and rare birds, while a night walk reveals a completely different world of nocturnal wildlife, led by expert local guides.

Enquire About This Tour
Nosy Tanikely

Tanikely Marine Reserve

One of Madagascar’s most beautiful protected marine reserves — vibrant coral reefs, tropical fish and a historic lighthouse.

Tanikely Marine Reserve

Nosy Tanikely

Snorkel in one of Madagascar’s most beautiful protected marine reserves. Vibrant coral gardens, tropical fish in abundance and a historic lighthouse make Tanikely a highlight of any Nosy Be itinerary.

Enquire About This Tour
Nosy Be

Horse Riding Adventure

Guided horseback rides along scenic beaches or forest trails — a unique perspective on Nosy Be’s natural beauty.

Horse Riding Adventure

Nosy Be

Guided horseback rides along scenic beaches or through forest trails, offering a unique and unhurried perspective on Nosy Be’s natural beauty. Suitable for all experience levels.

Enquire About This Tour
Nosy Be

Quad Biking Excursion

Off-road adventure through Nosy Be’s rural landscapes, villages and hidden coastal trails.

Quad Biking Excursion

Nosy Be

Off-road quad biking through rural landscapes, traditional villages and hidden coastal trails. An energetic and fun way to explore Nosy Be’s interior and coastline from a different angle.

Enquire About This Tour
Nosy Iranja

Nosy Iranja Excursion

Powder-white sandbank connecting two islands. Pristine beaches, excellent snorkelling, seasonal nesting turtles. Overnight option available.

Nosy Iranja Excursion

Nosy Iranja

Often described as one of Madagascar’s most beautiful islands, Nosy Iranja is famous for its powder-white sandbank connecting two islands at low tide. Day excursions offer pristine beaches and snorkelling; overnight stays reveal the island’s tranquillity after the day visitors depart. Seasonal turtle nesting.

Enquire About This Tour

West Madagascar

Morondava
Morondava

Avenue of the Baobabs

Towering centuries-old baobab trees lining a dusty road near Morondava — one of Madagascar’s most iconic landscapes.

Avenue of the Baobabs

Morondava

One of Madagascar’s most iconic landscapes — the Avenue of the Baobabs features towering, centuries-old baobab trees lining a dusty road near Morondava. Best visited at sunrise or sunset for exceptional photographic opportunities and a glimpse into the island’s unique natural heritage.

Enquire About This Tour
Morondava

Kirindy Forest Reserve

One of the best places to spot the elusive fossa, plus lemurs, reptiles and endemic birds in dry deciduous forest near Morondava.

Kirindy Forest Reserve

Kirindy, Morondava

Located near Morondava, Kirindy Forest Reserve is a hotspot for wildlife enthusiasts. Known for dry deciduous forest, it is one of the best places to spot the elusive fossa, along with lemurs, reptiles and endemic birds. Night walks are particularly rewarding.

Enquire About This Tour
Morondava

Baobab in Love

Two intertwined baobab trees near Morondava — symbolic, photogenic and steeped in local folklore.

Baobab in Love

Morondava

A short distance from the Avenue of the Baobabs, the Baobab in Love is a unique natural formation where two baobab trees have intertwined as they grew. Symbolic, photogenic and associated with local folklore — a memorable stop on western Madagascar tours.

Enquire About This Tour
Bemaraha

Tsingy de Bemaraha

UNESCO World Heritage Site. Dramatic limestone pinnacles, suspension bridges and hidden canyons — one of the world’s most extraordinary landscapes.

Tsingy de Bemaraha

Bemaraha

A UNESCO World Heritage Site, Tsingy de Bemaraha is famous for its dramatic limestone formations known as tsingy. This otherworldly landscape of sharp pinnacles, suspension bridges and hidden canyons is home to diverse wildlife including lemurs and rare birds.

Enquire About This Tour
Kivalo

Mangrove Tours in Kivalo

Navigate winding waterways by traditional pirogue, observe birdlife and learn about mangrove ecosystems on the western coastline.

Mangrove Tours in Kivalo

Kivalo

Explore the rich coastal ecosystems of Kivalo on a guided mangrove tour. Travelling by traditional pirogue, visitors navigate winding waterways, observe birdlife and learn about the importance of mangroves in supporting marine biodiversity and protecting local communities.

Enquire About This Tour

North Madagascar

Diego Suarez
Diego Suarez

Tsingy Rouge Park

Surreal red laterite rock formations near Diego Suarez. Vivid colours, unique geology and superb photography.

Tsingy Rouge Park

Diego Suarez

The surreal landscapes of Tsingy Rouge Park are formed from red laterite erosion, creating delicate sculpted formations unlike anywhere else in Madagascar. Best visited after rainfall when colours are most vivid — a striking stop for photography and geological interest.

Enquire About This Tour
Diego Suarez

Emerald Sea

A breathtaking turquoise lagoon protected by coral reef near Diego Suarez — accessible by traditional sailboat.

Emerald Sea

Diego Suarez

The Emerald Sea (Mer d’Emeraude) is a turquoise lagoon protected by a coral reef, one of the most beautiful marine environments in northern Madagascar. Accessible by traditional sailboat — ideal for swimming, snorkelling and relaxing in shallow, crystal-clear waters surrounded by pristine sandbanks.

Enquire About This Tour
Ankarana

Ankarana Special Reserve

Limestone massif with underground rivers, caves and razor-sharp tsingy near Diego Suarez. Rich wildlife, trails for all abilities.

Ankarana Special Reserve

Ankarana

Ankarana Special Reserve is a spectacular limestone massif featuring underground rivers, caves and razor-sharp tsingy formations. Rich in wildlife including lemurs, bats and reptiles, with a variety of guided trails ranging from easy walks to adventurous cave explorations.

Enquire About This Tour
Diego Suarez

Les Trois Baies

Three unspoiled bays — Baie des Sakalava, Baie des Pigeons and Baie des Dunes — connected by scenic coastal trails. White sand, turquoise water, kitesurfing.

Les Trois Baies

Diego Suarez

The coastal beauty of Les Trois Baies includes three unspoiled beaches connected by scenic walking trails. Known for white sands and turquoise waters, these bays are ideal for swimming, kite surfing or simply enjoying the raw natural beauty of the northern coastline.

Enquire About This Tour
Montagne d’Ambre

Montagne d’Ambre National Park

Cool montane rainforest with waterfalls, crater lakes and endemic lemurs, chameleons and rare birds — a refreshing highland escape.

Montagne d’Ambre National Park

Montagne d’Ambre

Set in a cool montane rainforest, Montagne d’Ambre National Park is one of Madagascar’s most biodiverse protected areas. Discover waterfalls, crater lakes and lush jungle trails while spotting endemic species such as lemurs, chameleons and rare birds. A refreshing highland contrast to the surrounding dry landscapes.

Enquire About This Tour
